rationale: The agent executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, directly violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. Additionally, the agent stated a specific refund amount ($10.48) that is not supported by any shown tool result, and the direction of a refund when moving to a larger size is questionable. Authentication appears to have been attempted via name and ZIP and actions seem limited to the user’s order, but the lack of confirmation and the unsupported monetary detail constitute clear failures under the stated pass criteria.
